findings.text: Missing CanConvert check for obj2 before calling Convert. If obj1 is time.Time but obj2 is a different non-convertible struct type, line 42 will panic. Failing input: obj1=time.Now(), obj2=custom struct{}.

0.reason: The finding identifies a panic in the same time.Time comparison code path, but the actual root cause is the UnixNano() overflow in the added struct case, which is the reference bug.
